changelog: - **A marketing visitor no longer leaks into the internship product through the chrome, the auth pages or the CTA** (#2356, epic #2348 — adversarial-review follow-up to #2474). The public header's wordmark was still the hard-coded string "InternshipCRM" and its aria-label said so; the footer tagline described mentors and mentees; the register page said "Sign up as a mentee — no invitation needed" and offered the mentor application; the sign-in page said "Sign in to your InternshipCRM account"; the landing's only conversion button, "Get started", pointed at `/auth/register`, where a token-less sign-up mints a **MENTEE in the internship default org**; and three demo links led to the internship demo. Now: a `useVertical()` client seam (`src/lib/verticalClient.tsx`, fed by the root layout through `Providers`) lets client components read the request's vertical, so the header wordmark is the vertical's product name; a marketing host shows no Register button and no demo links, its CTA is "Sign in", its register page opens the invitation field by default and hides the mentor link, and **`POST /api/register` refuses a token-less sign-up on a marketing host with 403 `invitation_required`** — marketing accounts are created by invitation. The MARKETING overlay now also covers `publicNav.homeLink/tagline` and `auth.signinSubtitle/registerSubtitle/tokenHint`, and four landing claims the review found untrue for this vertical were corrected (lead-source tracking needs the `sourcing` capability MARKETING lacks; merge is for people, not accounts; stage editing is a premium feature; every plan has a seat limit) plus the funnel box label now matches the preset ("Proposal sent"). One deliberate INTERNSHIP-visible detail: the public header's wordmark now reads the product name "Internship CRM" — what the sidebar, the footer (#2458) and the tab title already show — instead of the one-word literal "InternshipCRM" it alone still carried; everything else on the internship host is unchanged.

en: On the marketing product the header, sign-in and registration pages now speak marketing, the primary button is Sign in, and self-serve sign-up is refused — accounts are created by invitation.
tr: Pazarlama ürününde başlık, giriş ve kayıt sayfaları artık pazarlama dilinde; ana buton Giriş yap; self-servis kayıt reddediliyor — hesaplar davetle açılıyor.
de: Im Marketing-Produkt sprechen Kopfzeile, Anmelde- und Registrierungsseite jetzt Marketing, der Hauptbutton ist Anmelden, und die Selbstregistrierung wird abgelehnt — Konten werden per Einladung angelegt.
